spans.s:
f. (-क्षा)
Hunger.
E.
भुज to eat, in the desid. form, aff. अड् and टाप्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungry.
E.
बुभुक्षा hunger, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
Wishing to eat.
E.
भुज to eat, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-त्सा)
The wishing to know.
E.
बुध to know, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing to know.
E.
बुध to know, desid. v., उ aff.

f. (-षा)
Desire to be or become.
E.
भू to be, desid. v. affs. अङ् and टाप्.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to be or become.
E.
भू to be, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-र्षुः-र्षुः-र्षु)
1 Wishing to fill.
2 Desirous to nourish, &c.
E.
भृ to nourish, desid. v., उ aff.
